problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 59 cubic feet
* Package Beta: size 69 cubic feet
* Package Gamma: size 70 cubic feet
* Package Delta: size 51 cubic feet
* Package Epsilon: size 37 cubic feet
* Package Zeta: size 69 cubic feet
* Package Eta: size 48 cubic feet
* Package Theta: size 38 cubic feet
* Package Iota: size 54 cubic feet
* Package Kappa: size 48 cubic feet
* Package Lambda: size 37 cubic feet
* Package Mu: size 63 cubic feet
* Package Nu: size 42 cubic feet
* Package Xi: size 32 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
